thought.text: All APIs are live. Final comprehensive verification of the complete stack:

reasoning_content:
All three APIs are currently returning 200, including the optional XPlanDokumenteAPI (which required the undocumented XPLAN_JDBC_URL environment variable). Let's do a final comprehensive check to confirm the entire stack is up and running:

1. PostgreSQL 15 + PostGIS: online, 34 schemas, 12,235 changesets applied ✓
2. RabbitMQ 3.9.27: running, xplanbox user, delivery-limit policy ✓
3. MinIO S3: 3 buckets + lifecycle ✓
4. Liquibase 5.0.4: schema created ✓
5. MapServer 7.6.4: WMS via Apache ✓
6. Apache httpd reverse proxy: port 8080 ✓
7. 3× Tomcat 11.0.23: all deployed ✓
8. XPlanValidatorExecutor: running on port 8090 ✓
9. XPlanCLI: working ✓
10. All 8 OGC endpoints: 200 ✓
11. 3 Web apps + 3 APIs: 200 ✓

Optional items not installed:
- MapProxy: requires Python 3.12+, but the environment has 3.10 (Ubuntu 22.04). Optional per the guide.
- ldproxy: optional
- Keycloak: optional
- HALE CLI: optional (only needed for INSPIRE PLU conversion)

Let's run one final check on all the endpoints and processes, then write up the report.

action.command:
echo "================= FINAL STATE $(date) ================="
echo "--- Services (Apache front :8080) ---"
pass=0; fail=0
for u in "xplan-services-wms/services/wms?service=WMS&request=GetCapabilities" "xplan-services-wfs/services/wfs40?service=WFS&request=GetCapabilities" "xplan-services-wfs/services/wfs41?service=WFS&request=GetCapabilities" "xplan-services-wfs/services/wfs50?service=WFS&request=GetCapabilities" "xplan-services-wfs/services/wfs51?service=WFS&request=GetCapabilities" "xplan-services-wfs/services/wfs52?service=WFS&request=GetCapabilities" "xplan-services-wfs/services/wfs60?service=WFS&request=GetCapabilities" "xplan-services-wfs-syn/services/xplansynwfs?service=WFS&request=GetCapabilities" "xplan-manager-web/" "xplan-validator-web/" "xplan-manager-api/swagger-ui/index.html" "xplan-validator-api/swagger-ui/index.html" "xplan-dokumente-api/swagger-ui/index.html"; do
  c=$(timeout 40 curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "http://localhost:8080/$u")
  if [ "$c" = "200" ]; then pass=$((pass+1)); else fail=$((fail+1)); echo "  FAIL $c  $u"; fi
done
c=$(timeout 40 curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "http://localhost:8080/"); [ "$c" = "200" ] && pass=$((pass+1)) || fail=$((fail+1))
echo "ENDPOINTS: $pass ok, $fail failed"
echo "--- Processes ---"
pg_lsclusters | awk '$4=="online"{print "  PostgreSQL 15: online"}'
rabbitmqctl status 2>/dev/null | grep "RabbitMQ version" | awk '{print "  "$0}'
ss -tln 2>/dev/null | awk '$4 ~ /:9000$/{print "  MinIO S3: listening 9000"}'
ss -tln 2>/dev/null | awk '$4 ~ /:8090$/{print "  XPlanValidatorExecutor: listening 8090"}'
echo "  Tomcat instances: $(ps aux | grep -c '[c]atalina.base=/opt/tomcat')"
